## Problem

What are you trying to accomplish, and what gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the outcome you want, including how it should interact with existing duplicate detection, pause controls or exceptions.

## Alternatives and context

Mention workarounds, affected browsers and any privacy or accessibility considerations. Do not include private browsing data.
